purpose: Independently authored expected request options and descriptor metadata for the synthetic #316 fixture. Not a request, registration, run, authority or runtime result.

source.declaration: temper_ai/api/routes.py RunRequest and _start_run: request_options_json is canonical_bytes(body.model_dump(exclude={'admission'})), after Pydantic field parsing and before graph, default or notify parsing
source.limits: Uncommitted #198 source metadata. Not final CI evidence, installed source, runtime behaviour or authority. Rebind if that source moves.

inputs.semantics: Entire parsed mapping. Also bound independently to descriptor metadata_inputs_json. No workflow input defaults applied.

notify.semantics: Unparsed at this point. Capturing it proves no notify behaviour.

workflow.semantics: When both aliases are supplied the first validation alias is selected; the dump key is always workflow.

workspace_path.semantics: Candidate ingress requires exact equality with the descriptor's non-null workspace_path, so absent or null cannot satisfy an admitted descriptor. No fallback resolution.

excluded_from_options.admission: RunRequest.admission: str | None = None. Descriptor transport only, excluded to avoid a self-referential descriptor. Never authenticates descriptor or source pins.

unknown_http_fields: Ordinary Pydantic ignore: not forwarded into options and no authority. No new rejection policy is claimed or tested here.

entry_signatures._start_run: _start_run(body: RunRequest, *, execution_id: str | None = None) -> RunResponse
entry_signatures.submit_candidate: submit_candidate(*, descriptor_wire: bytes, caller: Caller | None, workflow_name: str, workspace_path: str | None, inputs: dict, request: FrozenJSON, execution_id: str | None, mode: str, bindings: CandidateBindings | None) -> str
entry_signatures.execution_id: Internal optional keyword, not a RunRequest field. If supplied it must equal the descriptor's preselected UUID; if absent the descriptor UUID is used, never a new random id or the logical run id.
entry_signatures.production_authority: Unbound and refused in this source piece (Temper HOME rm-02034875). V1 owes the real authority.

old306_correspondence: Old #306 INPUT request_inputs had the same single synthetic record_id value. Its run_id and workspace_path stay old-packet-only; this supplement uses distinct, labelled 316 identities.
